description: Activities and direct costs offered in the calculator's selectboxes, grouped by phase. phase is a research phase key ("incubation", "data" or "writing"). default_hours is a typical number of hours of labor for an activity. default_cost is a typical direct cost in US dollars. tooltip describes what the activity or direct cost covers.

activities.name: Ideation and conception
activities.tooltip: Developing the research question, reviewing the literature and designing the study.

activities.name: Ethics approval
activities.tooltip: Preparing and revising applications to an ethics committee or institutional review board.

activities.name: Grant applications
activities.tooltip: Writing, revising and submitting applications for funding for the project.

activities.name: Other
activities.tooltip: Any other incubation activity not listed above.

activities.name: Incubation (Overall Total)
activities.tooltip: The total hours of labor for the whole incubation phase, for when you only know the overall figure rather than a breakdown by activity.

activities.name: Data collection
activities.tooltip: Recruiting participants and gathering data, e.g. through surveys, interviews, experiments or fieldwork.

activities.name: Interview transcription
activities.tooltip: Transcribing recorded interviews or focus groups into text for analysis.

activities.name: Data analysis
activities.tooltip: Cleaning, coding and analysing the data, and interpreting the results.

activities.name: Other
activities.tooltip: Any other data collection or analysis activity not listed above.

activities.name: Data collection and analysis (Overall Total)
activities.tooltip: The total hours of labor for the whole data collection and analysis phase, for when you only know the overall figure rather than a breakdown by activity.

activities.name: Writing and manuscript preparation
activities.tooltip: Drafting, revising and formatting the manuscript for submission to a journal.

activities.name: Conferencing (labor)
activities.tooltip: Time spent preparing for, travelling to and presenting the research at conferences.

activities.name: Manuscript preparation (Overall Total)
activities.tooltip: The total hours of labor for the whole manuscript preparation phase, for when you only know the overall figure rather than a breakdown by activity.

direct_costs.name: Participant incentivization
direct_costs.tooltip: Payments, vouchers or gifts given to participants for taking part in the study.

direct_costs.name: Software
direct_costs.tooltip: Licences or subscriptions for software used in the research, e.g. for analysis or surveys.

direct_costs.name: Databases
direct_costs.tooltip: Access fees for databases or datasets used in the research.

direct_costs.name: Conferencing (direct costs)
direct_costs.tooltip: Registration fees, travel and accommodation for presenting the research at conferences.

direct_costs.name: Proofreading and Editing Services
direct_costs.tooltip: Professional proofreading, copyediting or language editing of the manuscript.
